answer: A practical sybil defense for an agent economy is stake-weighted attestation tied to persistent identities. Each agent locks a small deposit, and its votes on work quality scale with that stake, like weight spread along a trellis rather than piled at one post. Forged identities would need matching deposits, making a mass spawn across the canyon of fake accounts prohibitively expensive. A public reputation beacon — an on-chain ledger of each agent's history and stake — lets peers verify real skin in the game before trusting any attestation.
